2608.27219.title: BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing
2608.27219.paper_summary: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evaluate whether agents can reason over long-term signals to predict wellbeing scores paired with evidence-grounded rationales. To address this gap, we introduce BALMS, the first systematic benchmark of LLM-based agentic systems for longitudinal mental health sensing. BALMS spans 3 real-world longitudinal datasets, 2 task families (closed-form wellbeing-score prediction and rationale generation auto-graded by an LLM-as-Judge), 3 agentic paradigms evaluated across 5 open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We find that zero-shot agents rarely outperform a simple mean baseline, except with stronger backbones or compact, semantically meaningful features. Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning-oriented backbones, but does not guarantee temporal grounding or numerical correctness. Together with more analysis on efficiency and temporal scaling, BALMS highlights the need for longitudinal mental health agents that selectively retrieve history, ground temporal evidence, and reason over interpretable behavioral features.
2608.27219.paper_summary_zh: 心理健康評估依賴於情節自我報告量表，這些量表將主觀狀態（如壓力）轉換為數值分數，但僅提供稀疏的幸福感快照。可穿戴設備提供長期行為和生理信號，以進行持續、低負擔的監測。最近的基於大型語言模型（LLM）的個人健康代理使得對可穿戴信號進行自然語言查詢成為可能，但主要處理短期的檢索型查詢（例如，一週內的最高步數）。它們並未評估代理是否能夠基於長期信號進行推理，以預測與證據為基礎的合理性相結合的幸福感分數。為了解決這一缺口，我們介紹了BALMS，這是首個系統性基準，用於基於LLM的代理系統進行長期心理健康感知。BALMS涵蓋了3個真實世界的長期數據集、2個任務類別（封閉形式的幸福感分數預測和由LLM作為評判自動評分的合理性生成）、3個代理範式，並在5個開源和閉源的LLM骨幹上進行評估。我們發現，零-shot代理很少超越簡單的均值基準，除非使用更強的骨幹或緊湊且語義上有意義的特徵。思維鏈提示改善了以推理為導向的骨幹，但並不保證時間基礎或數值正確性。結合對效率和時間擴展的更多分析，BALMS突顯了對長期心理健康代理的需求，這些代理能夠選擇性地檢索歷史、基於時間的證據並對可解釋的行為特徵進行推理。
